No Alphabets and Digits

Let’s take a look at this page’s source code:

<script src="hook.js"></script>
<?php
// by escaping the payload you won't break this system, haha! :-)
$escaped = preg_replace("/[a-zA-Z0-9]/", "", $_GET['payload']);
?>

<script>
    // here you can inject an arbitrary script,
    // but I guess you can't do anything, cuz the script can't include a-zA-Z0-9 ! :-)
    <?= $escaped ?>
</script>


<h1>inject</h1>
<form>
    <input type="text" name="payload" placeholder="your payload here">
    <input type="submit" value="GO">
</form>

<h1>src</h1>
<?php highlight_string(file_get_contents(basename(__FILE__))); ?>

Just like we’ve previosly seen in Baby XSS 04, we come across preg_replace, a sanitization function that will search and replace regular expressions. In our case this function will remove (replace with an empty string "") all alphabetical characters, both lowercase and uppercase, and all digits from 0 to 9 from our payload:

$escaped = preg_replace("/[a-zA-Z0-9]/", "", $_GET['payload']);

It is most definitely impossibile to submit a “normal” payload without using these characters. We can however, use JSFuck, a JavaScript programming style inspired by Brainfuck that only uses six characters: [, ], (, ), !, and +.

By typing alert(document.domain) inside the JSFuck converter, we get
